questions.question: Explain how the CRJ totals of Kasi Cycles for November (Bank R21 000, Sales R15 000, Cost of sales R10 000, Debtors control R6 000) are posted to the general ledger.
questions.expected_answer: Bank is debited with R21 000, details Total receipts. Sales is credited with R15 000 and Debtors control is credited with R6 000, both with details Bank. Cost of sales is debited with R10 000, details Trading stock, and Trading stock is credited with R10 000, details Cost of sales. The folio for each is CRJ11.

questions.question: Show the debtors ledger account of Mzansi Couriers for November and prove that the debtors list agrees with Debtors control.
questions.expected_answer: Mzansi Couriers: balance 3 600; 4 Nov invoice 301 debit 4 500, balance 8 100; 20 Nov receipt 089 credit 3 600, balance 4 500. Greenway School balance R3 000. Debtors list 4 500 + 3 000 = R7 500. Debtors control 6 000 + 7 500 - 6 000 = R7 500. They agree.

questions.question: Prepare totals for Kasi Cycles' trial balance on 30 November and name two errors that a balanced trial balance would not reveal.
questions.expected_answer: Debits: Equipment 30 000, Trading stock 18 000, Debtors control 7 500, Bank 18 300, Cost of sales 15 000, Wages 3 500, Rent expense 3 000, Bank charges 200 = R95 500. Credits: Capital 62 000, Creditors control 11 000, Sales 22 500 = R95 500. Errors not revealed (any two): omission of a whole transaction; posting to the wrong account on the correct side; the same wrong amount on both sides (original entry); compensating errors.
